method: Public web search and fetch_page extraction; manually recorded fetched page metadata, not authenticated YouTube Data API or channel Analytics. Cached/stale responses possible. Counts are snapshots, not guaranteed live counts.
limitations: Purposive sample, not random or exhaustive.
No competitor CTR, impressions, retention, original historical thumbnails or A/B test logs.
Current views confound age, distribution, channel size, topic, video quality, format and thumbnail changes.
Opening transcript excerpts, not all transcript chunks or twenty full video watches.
Indexed visual references are a smaller, explicitly scoped subset; source mirrors may differ from YouTube thumbnails.

excluded.reason: Public-page fetch failed; no view count inferred.
